direction_population_diagnostic.decision_relevant_definition: union of anchors in the official nms_pre top candidate pool in either runtime

rationale: Protocol v1 applied hard maximum continuous-error bounds to final detections after discontinuous direction argmax and NMS operations. Its evidence showed microscopic medians with rare large maxima. PointPillars uses a two-class direction head, and final yaw adds pi according to the selected direction class; a near-tied direction-logit argmax can therefore produce an approximately 180-degree heading difference while retaining an almost identical geometric box axis. Protocol v2 preserves every sample, artifact, execution path, threshold, matching rule, and numerical tolerance. It changes only the aggregate continuous acceptance rule to a per-detection 99-percent pass fraction, separates modulo-pi box-axis yaw from heading agreement, and retains every exception. This refinement does not retroactively alter or pass the authoritative v1 failure.
